ei.title: How AI Machines Learn and Improve
ei.subject: 11월_2022 고1 모의고사
ei.lesson: How AI Machines Learn and Improve

fullPassage: You may have seen headlines in the news about some of the things machines powered by artificial intelligence can do. However, if you were to consider all the tasks that AI-powered machines could actually perform, it would be quite mind-blowing! One of the key features of artificial intelligence is that it enables machines to learn new things, rather than requiring programming specific to new tasks. Therefore, the core difference between computers of the future and those of the past is that future computers will be able to learn and self-improve. In the near future, smart virtual assistants will know more about you than your closest friends and family members do. Can you imagine how that might change our lives? These kinds of changes are exactly why it is so important to recognize the implications that new technologies will have for our world.

questions.passage: You may have seen headlines in the news about some of the things machines powered by artificial intelligence can do. However, if you were to consider all the tasks that AI-powered machines could actually (A)[perform / refuse], it would be quite mind-blowing! One of the key features of artificial intelligence is that it enables machines to learn new things, rather than requiring programming specific to new tasks. Therefore, the core (B)[similarity / difference] between computers of the future and those of the past is that future computers will be able to learn and self-improve. In the near future, smart virtual assistants will know more about you than your closest friends and family members do. Can you imagine how that might change our lives? These kinds of changes are exactly why it is so important to (C)[recognize / ignore] the implications that new technologies will have for our world.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 (A), (B), (C)에 들어갈 말로 가장 적절한 것끼리 짝지은 것은?

det.korean: (A) perform=수행하다, (B) difference=차이, (C) recognize=인식하다. 기계가 과업을 수행하고, 미래·과거 컴퓨터의 핵심 차이가 있으며, 함의를 인식하는 것이 중요하다.
det.analysis:
❌ ① refuse - difference - recognize: (A) refuse(거부하다)는 '과업을 수행할 수 있다'는 문맥에 반대
❌ ② perform - similarity - recognize: (B) similarity(유사성)는 '핵심 차이'라는 문맥에 반대
❌ ③ perform - difference - ignore: (C) ignore(무시하다)는 '함의를 인식하는 것이 중요하다'는 문맥에 반대
✅ ④ perform - difference - recognize: 원문 일치 ←정답

questions.passage: You may have seen headlines in the news about some of the things machines powered by artificial intelligence can do. However, if you were to consider all the tasks that AI-powered machines could actually perform, it would be quite mind-blowing! One of the key features of artificial intelligence is that it (A)[enables / prevents] machines to learn new things, rather than requiring programming (B)[general / specific] to new tasks. Therefore, the core difference between computers of the future and those of the past is that future computers will be able to learn and self-improve. In the near future, smart virtual assistants will know more about you than your closest friends and family members do. Can you imagine how that might change our lives? These kinds of changes are exactly why it is so (C)[important / trivial] to recognize the implications that new technologies will have for our world.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 (A), (B), (C)에 들어갈 말로 가장 적절한 것끼리 짝지은 것은?

det.korean: (A) enables=가능하게 하다, (B) specific=특정한, (C) important=중요한. AI가 학습을 가능하게 하고, 특정 과업에 맞춘 프로그래밍이며, 함의 인식이 중요하다.
det.analysis:
❌ ① prevents - specific - important: (A) prevents(막다)는 '학습을 가능하게 한다'는 문맥에 반대
✅ ② enables - specific - important: 원문 일치 ←정답
❌ ③ enables - general - important: (B) general(일반적인)은 '특정 과업에 맞춘'이라는 문맥에 반대
❌ ④ enables - specific - trivial: (C) trivial(사소한)은 '중요하다'는 문맥에 반대

questions.passage: You may have seen headlines in the news about some of the things machines (A)[powered / draining] by artificial intelligence can do. However, if you were to consider all the tasks that AI-powered machines could actually perform, it would be quite mind-blowing! In the near future, smart virtual assistants will know more about you than your (B)[distant / closest] friends and family members do. Can you imagine how that might (C)[change / preserve] our lives? These kinds of changes are exactly why it is so important to recognize the implications that new technologies will have for our world.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 (A), (B), (C)에 들어갈 말로 가장 적절한 것끼리 짝지은 것은?

det.korean: (A) powered=(동력을) 공급받는, (B) closest=가장 가까운, (C) change=바꾸다. AI로 구동되는 기계, 가장 가까운 친구·가족, 삶을 바꾸는 변화.
det.analysis:
❌ ① draining - closest - change: (A) draining(고갈시키는)은 'AI로 구동되는 기계'라는 문맥에 부적합
❌ ② powered - distant - change: (B) distant(먼)는 '가장 가까운 친구·가족'이라는 문맥에 반대
✅ ③ powered - closest - change: 원문 일치 ←정답
❌ ④ powered - closest - preserve: (C) preserve(보존하다)는 '삶을 어떻게 바꿀지'라는 문맥에 반대

questions.stem: 다음 글의 밑줄 친 ①~④ 중, 문맥상 낱말의 쓰임이 적절하지 않은 것은?

questions.passage:

❌ ③ (A): 핵심적인 - (B): 핵심적인: (B)는 '열쇠'
❌ ④ (A): 열쇠 - (B): 열쇠: (A)는 '핵심적인'

questions.stem: 다음 글의 빈칸에 들어갈 말로 가장 적절한 것은?

det.analysis:
✅ ① learn and self-improve: 학습하고 스스로 개선한다. 미래 컴퓨터가 과거와 다른 핵심 ←정답
❌ ② store more data: 더 많은 데이터를 저장한다. 본문 핵심 아님
❌ ③ run much faster: 훨씬 빨리 작동한다. 속도는 언급 없음
❌ ④ cost far less: 비용이 훨씬 적다. 무관
det.tip: future computers will be able to ______ → learn and self-improve
